construct_definitions_used.Power: Social status and prestige, control or dominance over people and resources
construct_definitions_used.Achievement: Personal success through demonstrating competence according to social standards
construct_definitions_used.Hedonism: Pleasure and sensuous gratification for oneself
construct_definitions_used.Stimulation: Excitement, novelty, and challenge in life
construct_definitions_used.Self-Direction: Independent thought and action - choosing, creating, exploring
construct_definitions_used.Universalism: Understanding, appreciation, tolerance, and protection for the welfare of all people and for nature
construct_definitions_used.Benevolence: Preserving and enhancing the welfare of people with whom one is in frequent personal contact
construct_definitions_used.Tradition: Respect, commitment, and acceptance of the customs and ideas that one's culture or religion provides
construct_definitions_used.Conformity: Restraint of actions, inclinations, and impulses likely to upset or harm others and violate social expectations or norms
construct_definitions_used.Security: Safety, harmony, and stability of society, of relationships, and of self

item_1.question_text: Thinking up new ideas and being creative is important to them. They like to do things in their own original way.

item_2.question_text: It is important to them to be rich. They want to have a lot of money and expensive things.

item_3.question_text: They think it is important that every person in the world be treated equally. They believe everyone should have equal opportunities in life.

item_4.question_text: It's very important to them to show their abilities. They want people to admire what they do.

item_5.question_text: It is important to them to live in secure surroundings. They avoid anything that might endanger their safety.

item_6.question_text: They think it is important to do lots of different things in life. They always look for new things to try.

item_7.question_text: They believe that people should do what they're told. They think people should follow rules at all times, even when no-one is watching.

item_8.question_text: It is important to them to listen to people who are different from them. Even when they disagree with them, they still want to understand them.

item_9.question_text: They think it's important not to ask for more than what you have. They believe that people should be satisfied with what they have.

item_10.question_text: They seek every chance they can to have fun. It is important to them to do things that give them pleasure.

item_11.question_text: It is important to them to make their own decisions about what they do. They like to be free to plan and to choose their activities for themselves.

item_12.question_text: It's very important to them to help the people around them. They want to care for their well-being.

item_13.question_text: Being very successful is important to them. They like to impress other people.

item_14.question_text: It is very important to them that their country be safe. They think the state must be on watch against threats from within and without.

item_15.question_text: They like to take risks. They are always looking for adventures.

item_16.question_text: It is important to them always to behave properly. They want to avoid doing anything people would say is wrong.

item_17.question_text: It is important to them to be in charge and tell others what to do. They want people to do what they say.

item_18.question_text: It is important to them to be loyal to their friends. They want to devote themselves to people close to them.

item_19.question_text: They strongly believe that people should care for nature. Looking after the environment is important to them.

item_20.question_text: Religious belief is important to them. They try hard to do what their religion requires.

item_21.question_text: It is important to them that things be organized and clean. They really do not like things to be a mess.

item_22.question_text: They think it's important to be interested in things. They like to be curious and to try to understand all sorts of things.

item_23.question_text: They believe all the worlds' people should live in harmony. Promoting peace among all groups in the world is important to them.

item_24.question_text: They think it is important to be ambitious. They want to show how capable they are.

item_25.question_text: They think it is best to do things in traditional ways. It is important to them to keep up the customs they have learned.

item_26.question_text: Enjoying life's pleasures is important to them. They like to 'spoil' themselves.

item_27.question_text: It is important to them to respond to the needs of others. They try to support those they know.

item_28.question_text: They believe they should always show respect to their parents and to older people. It is important to them to be obedient.

item_29.question_text: They want everyone to be treated justly, even people they don't know. It is important to them to protect the weak in society.

item_30.question_text: They like surprises. It is important to them to have an exciting life.

item_31.question_text: They try hard to avoid getting sick. Staying healthy is very important to them.

item_32.question_text: Getting ahead in life is important to them. They strive to do better than others.

item_33.question_text: Forgiving people who have hurt them is important to them. They try to see what is good in them and not to hold a grudge.

item_34.question_text: It is important to them to be independent. They like to rely on themselves.

item_35.question_text: Having a stable government is important to them. They are concerned that the social order be protected.

item_36.question_text: It is important to them to be polite to other people all the time. They try never to disturb or irritate others.

item_37.question_text: They really want to enjoy life. Having a good time is very important to them.

item_38.question_text: It is important to them to be humble and modest. They try not to draw attention to themselves.

item_39.question_text: They always want to be the one who makes the decisions. They like to be the leader.

item_40.question_text: It is important to them to adapt to nature and to fit into it. They believe that people should not change nature.
